property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array where the callee may revert or succeed, the reference C always reverts the whole transfer call if any callee invocation reverts (all-or-nothing); the mutant that ignores the callee's success flag can return true even when a callee reverts, violating that all-or-nothing rollback property for some inputs.
change_summary: Change call result handling to ignore the success flag and never revert on external call failures.
